Long story short: Don't use John Frieda "Breakage Prone Strengthening" Shampoos or Conditioners.  It is hair falling out bad news.  As for this duo, I got it to try and rectify the situation--which is sadly thinner hair.  After 2-3 weeks of use, the most I have noticed is that rather than 5-6 strands lost per brush stroke, I'm down to about 3-5 per overall brushing! Much better. Now I just have to wait for the other hairs to grow back in.  This is one of the few shampoos that didn't have any che

I used Paul Mitchell religiously years ago.  Rediscovered this.  Love it, smell perfect.  I have fine curly hair that I color.  No frizz, leaves hair softer snd fuller.  Highly recommend.  I've used so many high end brands, looking for the shine, fullness and natural look this is giving me.

I bought bottles of this product from UltaBeauty to compare with the bottles I got from this vendor.  While the shampoo seemed indistinguishable, the conditioner was distinctly different.  The conditioner from UltaBeauty had a strong lemon scent with a bit of sage, the product I got from this vendor had virtually no fragrance.  This could mean that the product here was either not genuine or it was outdated.  Don't know which.  Won't purchase here again.

AFTER. Using the Scalp Treatment from Paul Mitchell for a 10-30 minute soak in the tub, I use these and I love my hair!  I even use the thicker from the same line.  With the loss of my hair ... FROM using WEN ... I'm starting to see my hair grow back. Packaging was terrible ... only reason for the 4 stars!  Good thing they where in a sealed bag!  What a mess to clean but the pump is working even though the top is damaged.

reviews.t: Works wonders on my limp hair!
reviews.x: Love this shampoo & conditioner, gives my very thin hair lots of volume and also reduces the amount of oil in my hair. Only have to wash every other day instead of daily.

reviews.t: Must have for that much needed Volume!
reviews.x: I've tried the Original Tea Tree & I love it! I wanted to try something new since my hair needs that "oomph!" This shampoo is perfect for me. I have fine hair & this duo works like a charm! This is my 2nd purchase... Because my mum loved the shampoo (she had to try mine) and she loves it too! Delivery is surprisingly fast! I thought it will arrive after Christmas (New Year even!), it  arrived in less than 5 days!
Junk!  It's not Paul Mitchell, see pic.  Unlike other reviews I don't even think it smells good, it smells cheap.

So easy to ship my shampoo and conditioner.  Love the scent of this shampoo and it works well for my psoriasis.  When I use this thickening shampoo I do notice my hair is fuller feeling.  Great lather and rinses well without weighting hair down.  I just use the conditioner on my ends.  My dermo recommended tea tree oil shampoo for my skin psoriasis as well as scalp so I even use on my face and body in trouble areas.

This was my first time (against my hairdressers recommendation), buying Paul Mitchell Shampoo/Conditioner on Amazon.  I was wrong.  She was right.  I've used this hair care line for over 4 years now and I know the difference between what I purchase in store vs. now online.  The condition has a very thin consistency, and requires multiple pumps to even make my hair feel like its being conditioned.  I have no real complaints on the shampoo, it seems legit.  But the conditioner's formula must have

Not as good as I thought it'd be considered the price I paid for it. The scent doesn't last long and my girlfriend asks me if I've washed my hair on days that I've definitely showered. Don't think my hair feels any thicker either. I do enjoy the fragance while in the shower, but the cons outweigh the pros imo.

I purchased this product from Ulta; however I wanted to post about the product. I have untouched natural hair and wanted to buy volumizing shampoo/conditioner. After a month of use, hair became brittle and broke off. Additionally, turned red/orange. My hair is completely damaged!! DO NOT BUY THIS PRODUCT!

This is my favorite shampoo.  It makes a real difference with my have thin, graying hair.  Gives it shine and fullness,  Plus, the price for the combo pack was awesome.  Its a lot of $$ at once, but the bottles last a looooonnnggg time so it is a real bargain.

reviews.t: Highly recommended- try it for problem scalp
reviews.x: Have used this for years, great product for thin hair with irritated scalp (seborrheic dermatitis, eczema, severe dandruff) like mine. Works great, lasts a long time, perfect for daily use, and love the smell (don't care for the mint/lavender one.)
So I have fine frizzy hair. One the first use I could tell a difference in thickness. The smell is subtle and nice. I will buy more of this when I run out.
After using these products my hair is more manageable, soft and shiny.  I have also noticed that I am not losing as much hair as I was.

reviews.t: Clean, Soft, Shiny Hair --- even my father-in-law likes it!
reviews.x: I bought this on the advice of a hairdresser after my favorite Suave (Matrix knockoff) changed it's formula.  I have waist length, very fine hair,  and am pretty sensitive to heavily-scented products---I loved Herbal Essences long hair product until they changed their packaging and tripled the fragrance.  Anyway, I started with a small bottle of this and loved it.  It is not unscented---it smells delightfully of tea tree, peppermint, lemon and sage---but the essential oils don't bother me or my

reviews.t: Male pattern baldness runs in my family
reviews.x: Perhaps at the age of 22 this might be consider minimum preventive care,  but let tell you. This stuff works! I was expecting a nice smelling shampoo, but people actually noticed. Never in my life have people complimented my hair. But I've been getting compliments left and right. Best part, I've only been using it for 2 weeks. Bottles are huge, and will probably last me 6month-year. Never even tried conditioner before this, and love how it makes my hair feels. buy it, and save money in the long

reviews.t: Clean, Refreshing Scent and does a good job
reviews.x: It gives a clean and refreshing scent both the shampoo and especially the conditioner.  The shampoo cleans very well while still managing to both rid the hair of oil and maintain its softness and the conditioner adds further softness and style-ability.  The products can never be "Guaranteed" because they are not from a professional store however it seems that it works well and I am glad to use this product.  I formerly used just P Mitchell Tea Tree Special shampoo & conditioner however I

reviews.t: Great Price for a Great Product!
reviews.x: Hate to admit it, but I've suffered thinning and dry hair for most of my adult life. One of those things passed down from generation to generation, thanks.... Was told to try this shampoo and conditioner, told it works great. I would have to totally agree. After the first wash, hair was so smooth and felt so clean. Scent is a tad heavy, but doesn't linger too long, but it is a great scent. Seems like a steep price, but it's not, it's half the price of what you would pay in a regular store. So fa

reviews.t: Great for my fine long hair
reviews.x: Great for my fine long hair, keeps my hair looking good, thicker, and lustrous. As a mature white silver blonde woman, am noticing a lot less thinning  using this product compared to othe products I have used, Tea tree oil has so many healthy uses, cures many problems, it's a natural choice for hair and scalp. Enjoy the fragrance, and since one needs to use so little of the shampoo, it is quite economical.

Love the smell, not the results!  I hate to say it, because I love Paul Mitchell products, but I think this is stripping my color.  The conditioner is lightly conditioning and the shampoo is more like a clarifying shampoo.  Not my favorite.
I've really enjoyed this shampoo and conditioner so far. Worth the price! These are also quite big jugs of shampoo and conditioner.

reviews.t: Should've Bought this sooner **Update Dries Scalp
reviews.x: I've been using Dove and Head n Shoulders for a while. Since switching to this product, I am very satisfied with my decision. I have fine hair and though I've just recently started using the product, I feel like its giving my hair a more natural thick look. After showering and blow drying, it gives my hair a nice volumized bed head. I've seen almost all of the reviews, a couple people say this is not the real thing. I totally disagree. I have thin hair, and when I use this product I notice the swelling in my strands! This product is "the real thing" why would some sell this and make these bottles to put fake product inside. The seller is a real Salon. I'm impressed and I have done my research. The smaller bottle they sell at target is like $10.

claims.text: Many reviewers say the product adds volume and fullness to fine or thin hair.
Reviewers frequently praise the lemon sage scent.
Several reviewers suspect the product is not genuine Paul Mitchell or differs from store-bought versions.
Some reviewers report the product damaged their hair or caused breakage.
A few reviewers mention packaging or delivery problems.

qa.q: Will this make my hair feel thicker?
qa.answer: Reviews disagree: some say it made their hair feel thicker [2][4], while another says their hair didn't feel any thicker [1].

claims.text: One reviewer noticed a difference in thickness on first use [2].
Another reviewer felt it gave their fine hair a more natural thick look [4].
One reviewer did not think their hair felt any thicker [1].

qa.q: Is it safe for color-treated hair?
qa.answer: Not enough evidence in reviews to answer this.

qa.q: How does the tea tree and lemon sage smell?
qa.answer: Reviews describe the scent as delightfully tea-like [1] and clean and refreshing [6], though one reviewer notes it is lemon sage rather than the tingly regular tea tree [3].

claims.text: It gives a clean and refreshing scent.
It is lemon sage, not the regular tea tree that makes your scalp tingly.

qa.q: Does it dry out or irritate the scalp?
qa.answer: Reviews disagree: one user reports the product dries the scalp [2], while another says it works well for an irritated scalp [1].

claims.text: One reviewer reports the product dries the scalp.
Another reviewer says it works well for an irritated scalp.

qa.q: Is the liter duo a good value compared to buying separately?
qa.answer: Not enough evidence in reviews to answer this.
